## Incident Overview
Source: code review (passed) — minor finding not addressed in this session.
Finding: In the concurrent-create test, the redirected pipeline `bash ... 2>/dev/null | tail -1 >"tmp_id1"` means the exit status of the bash command is lost if it fails silently — errors could go undetected.
File: tests/scripts/test-ticket-e2e.sh
Category: verification
